Examples.Title: Get Dataset Rows
Examples.Code:
### Get Dataset Rows
# @name getDatasetRows
GET {{host}}/api/public/v2/datasets/{{dataset_id}}/rows?workspace_id={{workspace_id}}&page=1&per_page=10&q={{q}}
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

# 200
# Description: Paginated dataset rows.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid workspace_id

# Description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found - requested resource does not exist or is not accessible.
# Content-Type: application/json

# Description: Validation error - request parameters or body are invalid.

Examples.Title: Edit Evaluation Pipeline Column
Examples.Code:
### Edit Evaluation Pipeline Column
# @name editReportColumn
PATCH {{host}}/report-columns/{{report_column_id}}
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "report_id": 456,
  "column_type": "CODE_EXECUTION",
  "name": "Strict JSON check",
  "configuration": {
    "code": "import json\ntry:\n    json.loads(response)\n    return True\nexcept Exception:\n    return False",
    "language": "PYTHON"
  }
}

Examples.Title: Configure Custom Scoring
Examples.Code:
### Configure Custom Scoring
# @name updateReportScoreCard
PATCH {{host}}/reports/{{report_id}}/score-card
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "column_names": [
    "Accuracy Check",
    "Safety Check",
    "Format Check"
  ],
  "code": "check_columns = [\u0022Accuracy Check\u0022, \u0022Safety Check\u0022, \u0022Format Check\u0022]\npassed_rows = 0\nfor row in data:\n    if all(row.get(col) == True for col in check_columns if col in row):\n        passed_rows \u002B= 1\nscore = (passed_rows / len(data) * 100) if data else 0\nreturn {\u0022score\u0022: score}",
  "code_language": "PYTHON"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Score card updated.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found - requested resource does not exist or is not accessible.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Validation error - request parameters or body are invalid.
# Content-Type: application/json

### Patch Prompt Template Version
# @name patch_prompt_template_version
PATCH {{host}}/rest/prompt-templates/{{identifier}}
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "model_parameters": {
    "temperature": 0.5
  },
  "response_format": {
    "type": "json_object"
  },
  "commit_message": "Deploy with JSON mode",
  "release_labels": [
    "staging",
    "production"
  ]
}

Examples.Title: Patch Workflow
Examples.Code:
### Patch Workflow
# @name patchWorkflow
PATCH {{host}}/rest/workflows/{{workflow_id_or_name}}
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "commit_message": "Added logging node",
  "nodes": {
    "logger": {
      "node_type": "CODE_EXECUTION",
      "configuration": {
        "code": "print(f\u0027Processing: {input_data}\u0027)",
        "language": "PYTHON"
      },
      "dependencies": [
        "input_data"
      ],
      "is_output_node": false
    }
  }
}

## Responses
# 201
# Description: Workflow version created successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found - requested resource does not exist or is not accessible.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Validation error - request parameters or body are invalid.
# Content-Type: application/json

### Run Workflow
# @name runWorkflow
POST {{host}}/workflows/{{workflow_name}}/run
X-API-KEY: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "input_variables": {
    "user_message": "Hello"
  },
  "callback_url": "https://example.com/promptlayer/workflow-callback"
}
